node.html: Working at Adobe Inc. on a variety of Machine Learning projects to create new experiences with documents

I have 2+ years of experience in fields of Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Full Stack, and Cloud Services. My goal is to be engaged in Software Development building high-performance, robust and scalable ML applications, also by not being limited to certain technology stacks.

Currently I am a part of Adobe Document Cloud's AI & Innovation Team consisting a diverse lively group of engineers and scientists working on high visibility projects with ample room for creativity.

And, I am a photographer by hobby ;)
